positive_frame: dimension f=q(q+1)^2/2; unit inner products (q-1)/(q(q+1)) on collinear pairs and -1/q^2 on noncollinear pairs
negative_frame: dimension g=q(q^2+1)/2; unit inner products -1/q on collinear pairs and +1/q^2 on noncollinear pairs
decomposition: v=(q+1)(q^2+1)=1+f+g; the centered frames are the r=q-1 and s=-(q+1) eigenspace embeddings of the W(3,q) point graph
literature_context: Bagchi-Brouwer-Wilbrink, Geometriae Dedicata 39 (1991), determine dimensions of binary line/neighborhood codes for Sp(4,q) and dual O(5,q).
Lataille-Sin-Tiep, J. Algebra 268 (2003), determine complete mod-2 rank-3 permutation-module structure for odd-characteristic symplectic groups, with similar O(5,q) results.
boundary: The complementary real-frame theorem is all odd q. The binary identity rank_2(F)=g remains certified only at q=3,5,7 here, and the literature statements accessible in this run do not by themselves identify the P-component footprint minimum-distance theorem.
